say:1:1012442001:0.text: It seems that you've successfully acquired the Sylvan Egg.
say:1:1012442001:0.source_cn: 看样子，你们成功得到了翡绿之卵。

say:2:1012442002:1.text: Master Arden, how do you know this is the Sylvan Egg?
say:2:1012442002:1.source_cn: 贤者，您怎么知道这是翡绿之卵？

say:3:1012442003:1.text: Could it be... you've been to Ivoryshade?
say:3:1012442003:1.source_cn: 难道……你已经去过月影乡了？

say:4:1012442004:2.text: Ah, Bryon, my wise student. Nothing gets past you.
say:4:1012442004:2.source_cn: 布莱恩，令我骄傲的学生。什么都瞒不过你。

say:5:1012442005:1.text: Yes, before you all arrived, I found Ivoryshade and met the Deer Spirit.
say:5:1012442005:1.source_cn: 不错，在你们到来之前，我找到了月影乡的所在，并在那里见...

say:6:1012442006:1.text: The Deer Spirit tasked me to guide you there. Misarte wanted to meet you all.
say:6:1012442006:1.source_cn: 我是受鹿灵所托，指引你们前往月影乡。弥萨忒期待着与你们见面。

say:7:1012442007:1.text: I'm relieved that you passed her test.
say:7:1012442007:1.source_cn: 你们成功通过了祂的考验，我很欣慰。

say:8:1012442008:1.text: Is it possible to purify the Lucent Tree with the Sylvan Egg?
say:8:1012442008:1.source_cn: 使用翡绿之卵，是否能净化流荧树？

say:9:1012442009:2.text: No one knows unless one tries.
say:9:1012442009:2.source_cn: 不进行尝试，如何能得出结论。

say:10:1012442010:1.text: Magister Merlin, I've heard that you specialize in purification magic.
say:10:1012442010:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，我听说你擅长净化魔法。
say:10:1012442010:1.male: Magister Merlin, I've heard that you specialize in purification magic.
say:10:1012442010:1.female: Magister Merlin, I've heard that you specialize in purification magic.

choice_prompt:11:1012442010.text: Magister Merlin, I've heard that you specialize in purification magic.
choice_prompt:11:1012442010.source_cn: 梅林大人，我听说你擅长净化魔法。
choice_prompt:11:1012442010.male: Magister Merlin, I've heard that you specialize in purification magic.
choice_prompt:11:1012442010.female: Magister Merlin, I've heard that you specialize in purification magic.

say:13:1012442011:1.text: Master Arden, Magister Merlin used a lot of magic in the Dark Forest and needs to recover.
say:13:1012442011:1.source_cn: 雅顿贤者，梅林大人在薄暮丛林耗费了大量魔力，身体很虚弱。
say:13:1012442011:1.male: Master Arden, Magister Merlin used a lot of magic in the Dark Forest and needs to recover.
say:13:1012442011:1.female: Master Arden, Magister Merlin used a lot of magic in the Dark Forest and needs to recover.

say:14:1012442012:0.text: Then, we can only have Hewynn try. The purification ritual is very powerful magic. In her current state, I don't know if she'll be able to succeed.
say:14:1012442012:0.source_cn: 那么，只能让伊温试试了。净化魔法是非常高级的术式，以她...

say:16:1012442013:0.text: Yes, I don't know if I can complete the ritual right now.
say:16:1012442013:0.source_cn: 光靠我目前的力量……恐怕……

choice_prompt:17:1012442013.text: Yes, I don't know if I can complete the ritual right now.
choice_prompt:17:1012442013.source_cn: 光靠我目前的力量……恐怕……

say:18:1012442014:0.source_cn: 谢谢你……你真是个温柔的魔法师。

say:20:1012442018:0.text: Magister Merlin, let's do the purification ritual together.
say:20:1012442018:0.source_cn: 梅林大人，一起使用净化魔法吧。
say:20:1012442018:0.male: Magister Merlin, let's do the purification ritual together.
say:20:1012442018:0.female: Magister Merlin, let's do the purification ritual together.

choice:17:0:1.text: I'm here to help if you need.
choice:17:0:1.male: I'm here to help if you need.
choice:17:0:1.female: I'm here to help if you need.

say:23:1012442015:0.text: We can not let you use all your magic. I'll help too!
say:23:1012442015:0.source_cn: 不能让您一人消耗魔力，我也要帮忙！
say:23:1012442015:0.male: We can not let you use all your magic. I'll help too!
say:23:1012442015:0.female: We can not let you use all your magic. I'll help too!

say:25:1012442016:0.text: Hewynn, you're in bad shape. Don't push yourself.
say:25:1012442016:0.source_cn: 伊温……你的状态这么差，别逞强啊。

say:26:1012442017:0.text: Thank you for worrying about me, but I can do it. I failed to protect the Taran River. It's my duty to help.
say:26:1012442017:0.source_cn: 谢谢你为我担心，我可以的。没能保护好塔兰河……我有责任...
